consequence.statement: A GitHub Action used in the project's CI/release workflow was version-bumped; this does not touch the shipped chart, workloads, CRDs or operator configuration, so a deployed external-secrets installation sees no operational change.

assertion.statement: The external-secrets project bumped its pinned goreleaser/goreleaser-action GitHub Action from 6.2.1 to 6.3.0 (PR #4606); this is a CI/release-workflow dependency change with no effect on deployed external-secrets installations.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: goreleaser/goreleaser-action is a GitHub Action used in the project's own CI/release workflow; it is not present in a deployed external-secrets environment, so no environment-side predicate can express an exposure.
